title: tier policy put scope-critic on opus for an S-size scope (1.8M over 2 rounds)
detail: session-size-warning: scope-critic resolved to opus and cost 1.8M of 15.3M across two rounds verifying a 4-module S-size scope. Its catch (tier report lists only tier-predicted sprints) was a verify-against-code check within sonnet's reach. Candidate: scope-critic tier follows scope size, sonnet at S/M, opus at L/XL.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_sprint_cost.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
